candidates.content_text:
Company Description
Work with Us. Change the World.
At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.
There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.
We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.
Job Description
Play a key role in delivering a diverse range of exciting infrastructure projects across roads, commercial and industrial developments, sports, resources, water infrastructure, defence and renewable energy.
You’ll be responsible for developing high-quality civil design models, drawings and technical documentation across projects ranging from local roads and parklands to mine sites, dams, substations, BESS facilities, solar farms and wind farms.
What you'll be doing
- Develop detailed civil design models using 12d Model, including earthworks, roadworks, surface grading, DDA pedestrian access, pavements, drainage networks, culverts and open channels.
- Deliver designs across water and sewer infrastructure, including pipelines, water and sewer reticulation and pump stations, as well as stormwater and bio-retention systems.
- Produce high-quality drawings and documentation using AutoCAD, aligned with client requirements, industry standards and relevant government and regulatory requirements.
- Undertake geometry assessments and swept-path analysis to ensure designs are practical, safe and fit for purpose.
- Work collaboratively with multidisciplinary project teams, coordinating civil interfaces with architectural, structural, landscape, hydraulic, geotechnical, mechanical, electrical, communications, process and environmental disciplines.
- Contribute to design and model reviews, clash detection and safety-in-design activities, ensuring quality is embedded throughout the design process.
- Prepare and review technical inputs for Bills of Quantities, balancing safety, constructability, operational requirements and cost efficiency.
- Work directly with regional project teams to understand requirements, resolve technical queries and deliver work packages to agreed scope, programme and budget.
- Support quality assurance by checking your own work and, where appropriate, reviewing the work of less experienced team members in line with AECOM's quality procedures.
- Contribute to the ongoing improvement of our civil design capability through standard details, design libraries, digital workflows, lessons learned and continuous improvement initiatives.
Qualifications
What you'll bring
We’re looking for someone with a background in civil design and drafting who is keen to contribute to diverse, multidisciplinary projects. You don’t need to tick every box, if you have the right experience and attitude, we’d love to hear from you.
- Civil Engineering qualification (Associate Degree, Diploma, Advanced Diploma or Degree).
- 2+ years’ civil design and drafting experience, ideally across urban, rural, commercial, residential, industrial or mining projects.
- Strong experience in road geometry, pavements, earthworks, grading and drainage design.
- Advanced AutoCAD skills, with experience in 12d Model and vehicle tracking.
- Experience developing civil drawings, models and quantity take-offs.
- Strong communication and collaboration skills, including working with multidisciplinary and international teams.
- Experience with water and sewer infrastructure, including reticulation, pump stations, rising mains, pipelines and reservoirs, is highly regarded.
- Familiarity with relevant Australian standards and guidelines, including Austroads, QUDM, WSAA and IPWEA, is desirable.
- Experience taking designs from concept through to construction documentation, as well as working within multidisciplinary model review environments.
- Experience mentoring junior or cadet drafters and contributing to design capability development is advantageous.
You must be an Australian citizen and be eligible to obtain an Australian Government Baseline security clearance.

The West Gate Tunnel Project has given Melbourne a second freeway link between the west and the city - providing a much-needed alternative to the West Gate Bridge and a vital second river crossing.

Come and be a part of our centre of roads excellence
Job description:
VIDA Roads
VPS 5 - Civil Design Drafter
 - Hybrid working environment. 
 - 3 years maximum term, VPS 5 - $116,413 - $140,849 + super & benefits. 
 - This role will be located at 180 Lonsdale St
About the Role
Reporting to the Deputy Director Engineering, the Civil Design Drafter role is responsible for completing civil designs, drafting work and documentation for road infrastructure projects across the Big Build Roads (BBR) program from concept design to construction. The role requires thorough understanding of DTP's Infrastructure Drafting Standards and project handover requirements ensuring design models, plans and documentation are compliant. The role supports the Engineering - Development and Design team in delivering project documentation with accuracy, high quality and within the required timelines and budget.
Join us in building better connections for Victoria by:
 - Preparing accurate and high-quality civil design drafting and documentation for road infrastructure projects, including concept, detailed design and issued for construction documentation, ensuring outputs comply with relevant civil design, drafting and project requirements.
 - Interpreting engineering design information, technical inputs and project requirements to produce clear, complete and fit-for-purpose drawings, and work with engineers and project managers to resolve drafting, design and documentation issues.
 - Ensuring design documents are managed in accordance with VIDA Roads Digital Engineering Management Plan and document management procedures and compliant with DTP's Infrastructure Drafting Standards and project handover requirements.
 - Coordinating multi-disciplinary design documentation as required for the road infrastructure projects, ensuring design documents are delivered with high quality, within project timelines and budget and in accordance with the engineering and drafting requirements.
 - Supporting design engineers and utility managers by accurately incorporating BYDA and utility services information into CADD drawings, utility clash plans and registers to assist in the identification, documentation and resolution of utility interface issues
 About You
You would have:
 - Associate Diploma in Civil Engineering Design/Drafting or equivalent relevant qualification is mandatory
 - Knowledge and expertise in civil engineering design drafting and delivery of construction documentation for multiple disciplines specific to road infrastructure projects with various complexity and scale
 - Proficiency in the use of digital engineering tools and platforms required for design/drafting and management of road infrastructure project documentation (MicroStation, Open Roads, 12D, AutoCAD, ProjectWise, GIS).
 - Experience in interpreting and implementing design information provided by the design engineers with solid knowledge of DTP Infrastructure Drafting Standards, documented management and handover requirements, including an understanding of Austroads, DTP and Australian design and drafting standards for road infrastructure projects. 
This opportunity is a 3-year maximum term.
For more details about this opportunity, please take a look at the Position Description here.
What can we offer you?
We are committed to creating a workplace that inspires and engages you - we want you to be a powerful contributor to this wonderfully diverse and dynamic organisation. Our offering continues to grow but here 
is what we already have in store for you:
 - VIDA Roads welcomes flexible working arrangements.

LGC Traffic Management is a rapidly growing business located in Midvale, Western Australia. We are excited to be on the scout for a motivated, detail-oriented individual to join our team as a Civil Engineering Technician.

-  3 years of relevant work experience as a Civil Engineering Technician / Draftsperson

- Demonstrated proficiency in AutoCAD and GIS software for civil drafting and site spatial research.
- Practical understanding of fundamental civil works concepts, civil construction methodologies, and traffic management protocols.

The Eva Copper Mine Project is located on the traditional lands of the Kalkadoon People in Northwest Queensland, approximately 75 km north-west of Cloncurry and about 95 km north-east of Mount Isa.
The Project is an iron-oxide copper-gold resource featuring multiple open pits and is poised to become the largest greenfield copper mine in Queensland.
Learn more about the Eva Copper Mine Project.
Join us and hone your skills and develop new ones. Take on big challenges and grow through mentorship, collaboration, and empowerment.

Thiess is currently recruiting a Project Engineer - Civil for our Eva Copper Mine Project, located on the traditional lands of the Kalkadoon People, 75 kilometres north of Cloncurry and 95 kilometres north-east of Mount Isa.
This role is being offered as a max-term contract of between 12-18 months, providing a great opportunity to be part of an exciting new project!
As part of our commitment to supporting local communities, Thiess actively encourages applications from people living in North West Queensland, including members of the Kalkadoon community and other First Nations peoples. We also welcome applications from individuals who are willing to relocate to the region and become part of the local community.
As a key member of the Eva Copper Alliance team, you’ll be responsible for delivering high-quality mine planning and mine engineering processes to support safe, efficient operations and ensure our workforce meets Thiess and industry standards.

- Support the implementation of company systems and policies
- Assist with development of work schedules and construction progress tracking
- Track daily costs against budget and work with site supervisors to improve efficiencies
- Monitor quality to ensure client expectations and local authority standards are met
- Provide engineering support to on-the-ground supervisory staff
- Promote the Thiess Brand with external stake holders including clients and their consultants
- Maintain open communications and report all issues outside your authority to your Construction Manager

Your exceptional relationship-building skills, coupled with your ability to engage and collaborate effectively with a diverse range of stakeholders, will also ensure your success in this role.

- Excellent planning and coordination skills
- Capability to solve complex issues to arrive at best for project outcomes
- Strong communication skills that enable you to communicate at all levels

- Motivation to succeed and a desire to progress your career

- Salary sacrifice options

Thiess works with clients in Australia, Asia, and the Americas in the dynamic field of open-cut and underground mining. The pioneering spirit of our founders – the legendary Thiess brothers – is our legacy and has inspired our vision to harness the power of people and technology to drive sustainable change for more than 90 years.
Learn more about Our Vision, Purpose & Values.
At Thiess, we’re creating a culture of curiosity, knowledge-sharing and continuous learning – supporting our people to contribute to Thiess’ success and continued growth in sustainable mining.
We recognise the value of an inclusive and diverse workplace through our vision: everyone matters always. We’re focused on creating an inclusive environment to enable our people to bring their best self to work because they feel safe, included and empowered.
Learn more about working at Thiess.
How to Apply
This role is an opportunity to take the next step in your career. With our culture of recognition, development and a stimulating and satisfying work environment, there is no better time to join Thiess and the Eva Copper Alliance.
Please click the “apply” button below to apply for this role.
Thiess follows a Pre-Employment Process for all successful applicants, which includes two employment references, a National Police Check, and a medical assessment. These checks are essential to your application, and your recruiter will support you through the process.
Should you require assistance applying for this opportunity, please contact us at hiring@thiess.com.

Thiess does not charge fees at any stage of recruitment. If you receive messages asking for money, travel costs, or personal documents via unofficial channels, it is a scam.
Thiess recruitment representatives will only contact candidates using an official @thiess.com email address.

candidates.content_text:
Project Engineer | Your 2027 Civil Project Starts Here
2027 might feel a while away. Your next career move doesn't have to.
Unyte is preparing for new civil project opportunities commencing in Q1 2027, and we're starting conversations now with experienced Project Engineers already living and working in Queensland.
We're not looking for everyone.
We're looking for civil Project Engineers who enjoy being close to the work or FIFO, taking ownership and driving project delivery.
Engineers who understand that successful project delivery isn't just about hitting a program. It's about knowing your numbers, staying ahead of procurement, managing subcontractors, solving technical issues, maintaining quality and making sure the job is delivered safely.
You might be exactly who we're looking for if you're:
✓ Currently living in Queensland
✓ Have full Australian working rights
✓ Degree-qualified in Civil Engineering or equivalent
✓ Have a minimum 3 years' relevant civil construction experience
✓ Have proven experience delivering bulk earthworks, drainage, roads and associated civil infrastructure
✓ Experienced across programming, procurement, subcontractor management and productivity tracking
✓ Confident managing ITPs, QA, RFIs, drawings, specifications and non-conformances
✓ Commercially aware, with exposure to cost tracking, variations, progress claims and cost-to-complete
✓ Someone who works well with Project Managers, Supervisors, subcontractors, clients and site teams
✓ Considering your next career move in early 2027
At Unyte, you'll be involved in the real delivery.
You'll develop and manage short-term programs and keep critical activities moving.
You'll track productivity and costs.
You'll coordinate procurement, plant, materials and subcontractors.
You'll support variations, progress claims and commercial reporting.
You'll manage technical queries, drawings, RFIs and quality documentation.
You'll work closely with site teams to manage high-risk activities and maintain strong HSEQ standards.
You'll build relationships with clients and their representatives.
And you'll work alongside experienced project leaders while continuing to develop towards the next stage of your civil construction career.
We're looking for genuine civil construction experience.
For these opportunities, hands-on experience delivering bulk earthworks, drainage, roads and associated civil infrastructure is essential.
We're particularly interested in Project Engineers who understand how projects come together from both an engineering and commercial perspective, and who are comfortable taking responsibility for a package or component of works.
Your next project doesn't need to be another project.
Make it the one that moves your career forward.
If you're a Queensland-based Project Engineer with strong civil construction experience, full Australian working rights and you're thinking about making a move in Q1 2027, we'd like to hear from you.
A career with us
At Unyte, we've always known that people and performance make amazing things happen. Work like ours needs problem solvers, bold thinkers and genuinely good people. If you're looking for a passionate team and a pathway to career success, now's the time to make it yours.
There are plenty of good reasons to dig into a career at Unyte.
 - Forge pathways: We open doors to diverse, challenging and future-shaping construction projects to expand your experience and develop your career.
 - Get ahead: From early career support and specialised learning to leadership development, we back you with tailored development programs to help you reach your goals. Success is defined by your direction and progress.
 - Keep well: A healthy and happy workplace builds a brighter future. With wellness benefits, discounted health insurance, a perks and rewards platform and an industry-leading employee assistance program, we're here to support you when you need it.
 - Stay social: People are the core of Unyte. Our leading-edge work and breakout spaces stocked with snacks bring the best out of our teams and keep them fuelled for their next challenge, while our social calendar is stacked with events to connect, celebrate and reward our people.
 Diversity of thought fuels our progress
Our inclusion offerings are designed to open doors for individuals who may not see a traditional entry point into the construction industry. We're empowering women to thrive in construction through Shine, championing veteran career transitions through Resolve and building meaningful careers for Aboriginal people with Wamarra - helping you build a future where you belong.
Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, veterans and individuals from diverse cultural and life experiences are encouraged to apply.

At the heart of our Transport & Infrastructure Group, you’ll work with cutting-edge technology and a culture of innovation to design smarter, safer, and more sustainable drainage systems. From highways to airports, your work will help connect communities and build resilience across the state.

Precast Concrete Drafter – Full Time
All Cast NT | Darwin, NT | On-site or Remote
Full-Time | Monday–Friday | Occasional Saturdays
About Us
All Cast NT is an established precast concrete manufacturer based in Darwin, Northern Territory. We manufacture a broad range of civil and structural precast concrete products for major infrastructure, defence, commercial and industrial projects.
Our products include structural wall panels, culverts, drainage pits, headwalls and custom precast elements.
We are looking for an experienced Precast Concrete Drafter to join our team on a full-time basis.
The position is based in Darwin, however, we are open to suitably experienced applicants working remotely from elsewhere in Australia or overseas.
About the Role
You will be responsible for preparing accurate, detailed precast concrete shop drawings and manufacturing documentation to support our production team.
The role requires someone with practical precast concrete drafting experience who understands how drawings translate into manufacturing.
Key Responsibilities
- Prepare detailed precast concrete shop drawings using AutoCAD.
- Produce drawings for structural panels, culverts, drainage products and other custom precast elements.
- Detail reinforcement, cast-in components, lifting points, connections, penetrations and other manufacturing requirements.
- Interpret engineering drawings, structural specifications and project documentation.
- Prepare and revise drawings in accordance with engineering and client requirements.
- Coordinate with engineers, project managers and production staff to resolve drawing queries.
- Maintain accurate drawing registers, revisions and documentation.
- Ensure drawings are accurate, complete and suitable for manufacturing.
- Manage drafting priorities to meet production schedules and project deadlines.
About You
Essential Requirements
- Demonstrated experience drafting precast concrete elements.
- Proficient in AutoCAD.
- Strong understanding of precast concrete manufacturing, reinforcement detailing and construction drawings.
- Ability to interpret structural engineering drawings and specifications.
- High attention to detail and accuracy.
- Ability to work independently, manage workloads and meet deadlines.
- Good communication skills and ability to coordinate with production and engineering teams.
Highly Regarded
- Experience with structural precast wall panels and civil drainage products.
- Experience with reinforcement detailing, lifting systems and cast-in components.
- Familiarity with Australian construction standards and precast manufacturing practices.
- Experience working directly with precast manufacturing facilities.
- Experience with 3D drafting software, including Revit or Tekla.
Working Arrangements
- Full-time position, Monday to Friday, with occasional Saturday work as required.
- Working hours aligned with Darwin (ACST), generally between 7:00–8:00 am and 4:00 pm.
- Darwin-based applicants preferred, however remote applicants from Australia considered.
- Remote applicants must be available during Darwin business hours and able to communicate effectively with our local team.
What We Offer
- Full-time, ongoing employment.
- Competitive remuneration based on experience and capability.
- Opportunity to work across a broad range of civil and structural precast projects.
- Direct involvement with manufacturing, engineering and project delivery.
- Flexible location arrangements for suitably experienced applicants.
How to Apply
Please submit your CV along with examples of precast concrete shop drawings you have personally prepared.
In your application, please include:
- Your experience in precast concrete drafting.
- Your level of AutoCAD proficiency.
- Your current location and availability.
- Your salary expectations.
Applicants must have demonstrated precast concrete drafting experience.

candidates.content_text:
About Us 
 Established in 1980, Structerre Consulting has become a trusted leader in the Australian construction industry. Our expertise spans structural, civil, and geotechnical engineering, supported by integrated services including site investigations, laboratory testing, surveying, inspections, and energy assessments. With a practical, client-focused approach, we help shape projects nationwide and deliver quality outcomes with confidence.
 Structerre Consulting is backed by Five Group, a national network of engineering, surveying, consulting, and professional services businesses. Through this connection, we benefit from shared expertise, strong operational support, and a collaborative network that strengthens our capability and creates opportunities for our people and clients across Australia and South-East Asia.
 Location: Perth, WA
 Our Benefits 
 - Employee Assistance Program and self-care programs
 - Access to a range of internal and external professional development programs
 - Positive and nurturing culture
 - Recognition, rewards, and mentorship from experienced leaders
 - Exclusive employee discounts
 - A meaningful, rewarding career within a supportive team
 Your Role
 As a Graduate Structural & Site Engineer, you'll build practical experience across both site and office environments, working alongside experienced engineers on a diverse range of residential and commercial projects. From structural inspections and investigations to engineering assessments and reporting, you'll develop the technical and practical skills that form the foundation of a successful engineering career.
You’ll:
 - Conduct structural inspections, compliance inspections, and site investigations across residential and commercial projects.
 - Gather site information and prepare clear, accurate inspection and investigation reports.
 - Assist with structural assessments, engineering calculations, and technical documentation.
 - Utilise structural engineering software and CAD packages to support project delivery and residential design activities.
 - Liaise with clients, builders, contractors, and internal stakeholders both on-site and in the office.
 - Develop your technical expertise through mentoring, practical field experience, and exposure to a broad range of engineering projects
 What You’ll Bring
 - Recently completed, or nearing completion of, a Bachelor of Civil or Structural Engineering.
 - A genuine interest in structural engineering and the construction industry.
 - Understanding of structural design principles, the NCC, and relevant Australian Standards.
 - Experience using structural engineering software and CAD packages.
 - Strong attention to detail, problem-solving, and time management skills.
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work independently and within a team.
 - Valid Australian Driver's Licence and Construction White Card, with a willingness to undertake regular site inspections and field-based activities where required.
 WE ENCOURAGE YOU TO APPLY 
 We encourage you to apply and become part of a team where your contribution is valued and your career can grow. At Five Group, we're committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where people can thrive and succeed. Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted as we progress through the selection process. 
 Recruitment agencies: our Talent Acquisition team recruits directly and will contact selected partners if external support is required.
Applicants must possess unrestricted Australian work rights and not require sponsorship at any stage during their employment.

Our Region
Gladstone offers dynamic career opportunities across diverse industries, catering to a range of skills and ambitions. Whether you're advancing your career or seeking work-life balance, Gladstone's industrial strength, innovative energy projects, and bustling service sectors make it a fantastic place to work and live.
You’ll be glad you made it!
Our Council
Discover a fulfilling career at Gladstone Regional Council, where your dedication to community service merges with our commitment to improving residents’ lives. Every role contributes to the livelihood of those who call Gladstone home.
We are committed to building an inclusive workplace that reflects the diversity of the entire community we serve. At Gladstone Regional Council, we embrace diversity in our collective pursuit of inclusion. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone, regardless of gender, age, marital status, sexual orientation, disability, ethnicity, or background, can thrive. As a child safe organisation, Gladstone Regional Council are committed to the safety, wellbeing and empowerment of all children and young people. Inclusion is at the heart of our culture.
View our Access and Inclusion Action Plan, Reconciliation Action Plan and Child Safety and Wellbeing Policy
Our Culture & Our Benefits
Join our supportive and collaborative culture where your well-being comes first. We’re committed to nurturing your holistic wellness through health programs and events, our culture journey and flexible working options.
We partner with our people to understand their needs and provide the tools that develop skills, knowledge and healthy culture. Our people are valued for the part they play in delivering for the Gladstone Region. We are proud of who we are and what we do. We are #ProudlyGRC!
Find out more here Better Balance, Better Benefits with GRC
Engineer (Civil)
Council is seeking to appoint a permanent full time Engineer (Civil) to contribute to Council’s success.
- Permanent full time, 9-day fortnight
- Learning and development opportunities
- Better Balance, Better Benefits with GRC
About the Role
The purpose of this position is to provide specialised technical engineering support and advice to internal and external customers, primarily relating to transportation and drainage assets.
The position will make an important contribution to achieve Council’s objectives for excellence in asset management and customer experience.
You will bring:
- Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering (or a related discipline).
- Knowledge of relevant Acts and Regulations, engineering guidelines and standards.
- Analytical, problem solving, and negotiation skills to effectively conduct a range of Investigative/Design duties.
- Advanced report writing skills.
- Eligibility for membership of the Institution of Engineers Australia.
- Experience communicating with contractors, service authorities, consultant engineers and internal and external customers.
- Experience in the application of Engineering Design Guidelines applicable to a local government environment (e.g. Austroads and Water Services Association of Australia), relevant acts and regulations and standards.
- Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a team and independently.
- Proficient keyboard skills and experience using Microsoft Office Suite and operating corporate business systems.
- Legally able to drive a motor vehicle in Queensland.
Eligibility & Pre-employment Checks
To be eligible for this position, the candidate must have applicable working rights.
Depending on the role requirements, you may need to complete various checks and assessments as part of the recruitment process. This could include reference checks, pre-employment medicals (including drug and alcohol testing), vaccinations, visa checks, licence verifications and psychometric testing.  
For questions related to the role or recruitment process, please call Council on (07) 4970 0700 or email the Talent Acquisition Team at employment@gladstone.qld.gov.au.
Closing Date
There is no set closing date as Council will review applications periodically and will withdraw the advertisement once the position has been filled.

- A genuine interest in building a career in Civil Construction
- Strong work ethic and willingness to learn
